scope: Read-only post-freeze resource audit; initial retained supervised Windows stages, common setup/reference and selected Phase6 preparation separated

definitions.wall_sum: Sum of retained supervised stage elapsed values including failed stages and idle/UI wait. Overlap may exist; not active development time or total calendar wall time.
definitions.cpu_sum: Sum of measured Job Object process-family CPU over distinct recorded invocations. Missing timeout CPU excluded and explicitly listed; not complete task CPU.
definitions.memory: Maximum of measured per-job simultaneous family committed-memory peaks. Not sum of peaks, not RSS, not a whole-project/processes-across-jobs peak.
definitions.deduplication: Raw metrics invocation tuple (started_at,pid,cwd,argv), requiring matching exit/wall/CPU/peak for aliases. Canonical live roots precede retained archives. Summary/ledger and nested manifest copies are provenance, never additional stages.
definitions.ownership: PID is preserved only as historical invocation metadata. No process is considered currently owned or killed by this audit.
definitions.arm_comparability: Unequal retained stage counts, failed/no-work/cache/UI tasks and measurement boundaries; no equal-budget or REA causality claim.

membership_sources.B_time_boundary: started_at <= B frozen_at_utc; existing live canonical input records selected at collection time; not a reconstruction of unrecorded work

overlapping_stage_intervals.meaning: overlapping recorded stages; not duplicate by invocation identity, not additive development wall time. Process-family containment cannot be inferred from interval alone.

limitations: Evidence counts and retained serialized bytes are actual exported observations, not agent tokens or runtime/memory costs.
Canonical exported records inspected contain no measured elapsed/duration/CPU/peak resource fields. PE resource timestamps are artifact metadata.
analysis_profile native_aot_metadata working_memory_bytes/source_bytes/report_bytes are configured limits, not measured consumption.
Ghidra/JVM/provider setup, analysis, re-use/cache and tool transport CPU/memory are not measured by the product CMake/Qt Job records.
Older exports, inventories, snapshots and index files overlap these evidence records and are not added as independent analyses.

unmeasured.goal_counter: Cumulative agent-runtime metadata only; get_goal usage is not per-arm billable input/output token usage and is not converted to dollars.
scope_exclusions: Linux resources are not Job Object Windows metrics; retained separately in earlier ledgers/logs.
Desktop automation, model inference, shell/Python audit work, package assembly and downloads without these supervised records remain unmeasured.
Root is running sequential Phase6 product benchmarks; those evolving comparison measurements are excluded here and owned by their separate report.
